g.text: Round 16 | Same algorithms across two historical periods
Both feature families use 25 coordinates, the same fixed L2 penalty and a 0.5 probability threshold. Learned probabilities average three seeds.
The simple-feature model is deterministic. Dotted line: neutral 0.5 Brier. All dates were previously inspected; this is exploratory evidence.
